0022600225.text: The Warriors (8-3, eight-game winning streak, 2nd in the Pacific, 4th in the West) head to Houston (8-3, 7-3 in their last ten, 2nd in the Southwest) for the Warriors' 12th game of the season. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Will Richard, while Brandon Williams and Gary Payton II are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; Houston is missing Clint Capela and Steven Adams, with Oscar Tshiebwe day-to-day and also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-2 in the season series, including a 117-116 loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
